stewards.name: x402 Foundation (x402 a Series of LF Projects, LLC)
stewards.role: Governs the protocol under a technical charter adopted 2026-03-31; Linux Foundation project since 2026.

stewards.name: Technical Steering Committee: Coinbase, Cloudflare, Stripe
stewards.role: Votes on technical decisions; named in TSC.md on 2026-05-12.

stewards.name: Coinbase Developer Platform
stewards.role: Originated x402 and wrote the 2025-05-06 whitepaper; runs the largest facilitator.

implementers.name: Coinbase CDP facilitator
implementers.role: Facilitator on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, World and Solana with KYT and OFAC screening.

implementers.name: Facilitators listed in the x402 docs (PayAI, Corbits, Dexter, Fireblocks, Polygon, Celo, NEAR x402 Facilitator, T54 XRPL and others)
implementers.role: Independent verify and settle services; the docs say the list is not exhaustive.

implementers.name: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway
implementers.role: Closed beta that settles USDC on Base through Coinbase's facilitator; US sellers and buyers only.

implementers.name: Cloudflare Agents SDK and AI Gateway
implementers.role: withX402 and paidTool for agents and MCP servers since 2025-09-23; AI Gateway accepts PAYMENT-METHOD: x402.

implementers.name: Circle Nanopayments (Circle Gateway)
implementers.role: Gas-free USDC payments from $0.000001 using EIP-3009 inside the x402 flow, batched settlement.

implementers.name: Stripe machine payments preview
implementers.role: Charges agents in USDC on Base through x402 (reported).

implementers.name: Coinbase Agentic Wallets
implementers.role: Agent wallets reported to transact through x402.

implementers.name: x402scan (Merit Systems)
implementers.role: Explorer, registry and public API for x402 activity.

implementers.name: Google a2a-x402 and AP2 samples
implementers.role: A2A extension and human-present and human-not-present x402 samples.

sdks.note: Legacy V1 package (unscoped); x402-axios, x402-express, x402-fetch, x402-hono and x402-next are V1 too.

metrics.definition: npm registry download count for the V2 core package.
metrics.caveat: Includes CI installs; the legacy V1 package x402 had 2,007,353 in the same window.

metrics.definition: Self-reported counter on x402.org; the page displayed this on 2026-10-10 with "Last updated: 2026-08-25".
metrics.caveat: Raw count, not adjusted for wash activity; appears not updated since at least mid August 2026.

metrics.definition: Self-reported counter on x402.org, read on 2026-10-10.
metrics.caveat: The same figure was reported for mid August 2026 by Crypto Briefing.

metrics.definition: Cumulative data to 2026-04-21 after removing activity Artemis classes as non-organic; average $0.14 per transaction.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report of a Visa and Artemis chart; Visa's Cuy Sheffield separately cited about $19M across about 134M.

metrics.metric: Share of transactions flagged as gamed (Artemis)
metrics.definition: Average share flagged between 2025-11-09 and 2026-02-07; peak 90.21 percent.
metrics.caveat: Secondary analysis; the detection logic is not published.

metrics.definition: Settlements over a 280 day window, from arXiv:2607.12575.
metrics.caveat: The paper argues settlement counts are not adoption because they can be manufactured almost for free.

metrics.definition: Claim in the V2 launch post.
Quote from Rishin Sharma (Solana Foundation) in the Linux Foundation release of 2026-04-02, for 2026 to date; a self-reported figure from an interested party.
metrics.caveat: About 70 percent of monthly volume was reported for mid August 2026, while Base held about 90 percent of adjusted transactions in Visa and Artemis data; volume share and transaction share differ.

metrics.definition: Range across trackers reported by Crypto Briefing.
Members at the operational launch, 17 of them Premier.
metrics.caveat: The listed names count 39 or 40 depending on one combined entry.

costs.value: First 1,000 on-chain transactions each month free, then $0.001 per on-chain transaction
costs.caveat: Counts on-chain transactions, not payment requests; prices change without notice.

costs.value: exact and EVM upto: one; Solana upto: two; batch-settlement: one claim covers many vouchers
costs.whoPays: Facilitator pays gas, recovered through its fee
costs.caveat: Deposits, refunds and withdrawals in batch-settlement count as one transaction each.

costs.value: PayAI: on-chain gas plus 30 percent per settlement since 2026-09-21, paid in $0.001 credits, with 1,000 free credits per receiving wallet for life (about 650 Solana or 430 Base settlements); thirdweb 0.3 percent (secondary); self-hosted pays only gas and operations
costs.caveat: PayAI figures from its own pricing docs; its facilitator home page still showed an older plan. The thirdweb figure comes from a secondary comparison of 2026-07-12; verify on the vendor page.

costs.value: Base about $0.005 to $0.01; Solana about $0.001 to $0.005; Ethereum L1 about $1 to $5
costs.whoPays: Facilitator on the exact EVM path and as Solana fee payer, or the merchant when it sponsors
costs.caveat: Secondary mid-2026 estimate under normal congestion.

costs.value: Payments from $0.000001 USDC; no per-transaction fee schedule published
costs.whoPays: Not stated (buyers sign off-chain at zero gas)
costs.caveat: Who pays the batch settlement gas is not stated.
x402 itself charges nothing; costs are facilitator fees and gas. cloudflare:402 is credit billed by Cloudflare as merchant of record under its own terms.
